title: Sparse-fuse Rollout Scheduler with Delta Quarantine and Micro-sampling Rehearsal
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: production rollouts increasingly require fine-grained, low-cost sampling across cohorts to detect regressions without high traffic overhead. This change introduces a Sparse-fuse scheduler that interleaves micro-sampled traffic (sparse fuse lanes) with standard canary/A-B lanes and a Delta Quarantine subsystem that quarantines cohorts when statistically significant deltas are detected across a configured metric set. Summary: implement a scheduler that maintains per-cohort micro-sampling tokens, a quarantine controller that triggers automated isolated rehearse-replay probes, and CI/console hooks to visualize sparse lanes and quarantine decisions. This PR contains: 1) new scheduler engine (server/rollout/scheduler.go) implementing fused scheduling and tokenized micro-sampling, 2) delta detector and quarantine lifecycle manager (server/rollout/quarantine.go) with configurable thresholds and backoff, 3) integration test harness for replayed micro-samples (tests/integration/sparse_fuse_rehearsal.test), 4) Console UI additions to show sparse lanes and quarantine state (console/ui/rollouts/controls.tsx, console/ui/rollouts/quarantine_view.tsx), 5) telemetry and metrics for sparse sampling rate, quarantine triggers and replay success (telemetry/metrics/rollout_metrics.prom), 6) helm values and operator tweaks to enable feature gates (operator/helm/values.yaml). Backwards compatibility: default behavior is inert unless feature gate rollout.sparseFuse=true; existing rollout specs remain valid. Rollout plan: staged rollout to internal clusters with 0.1% sparse fuse enabled for two days, then raise to 1% with quarantine enabled. Safety: quarantine isolates traffic and automatically replays sampled requests to a shadow instance for validation before rollback; any quarantine with repeated failures escalates to on-call via PagerDuty integration already wired into the quarantine manager. Testing: unit tests for scheduling logic, deterministic simulation harness for delta detection, and an end-to-end integration test included. Related work:ENG-8247 implements the sampling API used here; ENG-8301 tracks quarantine playbook automation. Checklist: [x] design doc reviewed [x] unit tests added [x] integration test added [x] doc stub added [x] console changes verified locally. Notes: tuned default thresholds conservatively to avoid false positives; telemetry export includes delta magnitude and sample counts for offline analysis.

change_summary: Adds fused micro-sampling scheduler to enable low-cost per-cohort sampling
Implements automated quarantine lifecycle and replay-based validation
Console and telemetry additions for operator visibility
Feature gated and opt-in via helm / operator flags
notes_for_ops: Enable rollout.sparseFuse feature gate in operator/helm/values.yaml to turn on the feature
Start with sparseSampling.rate=0.001 for initial traffic and monitor rollout_sparse_sample_count and quarantine_trigger_count metrics
Quarantine records auto-archive after 30d by default; configurable via operator values
